newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-BARCELONA FACE LAS PALMAS IN CUP SEMIFINAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BARCELONA FACE LAS PALMAS IN CUP SEMIFINAL.

text.p: Barcelona will play Las Palmas in the semifinals of Spain's King's Cup while Seville's Real Betis will take on Celta of Vigo.
The draw made on Friday pitted Barcelona, who have beaten both Real and Atletico Madrid on their way to the final four, against the only second division side left in the competition.
The semifinals will be played over two legs. First leg ties will be played on March 26 and 27 with return matches on April 2 and 3.
The winners of the King's Cup, Spain's premier cup competition, qualify for the European Cup Winners' Cup.
